data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 放学教室夕阳下的挺胸伸展
data.description: 夕阳染红的驹王学园空教室，伊莉娜站在课桌旁舒展身体，修身西装制服勾勒出饱满挺拔的身材曲线。
data.location: 落日余晖下的空旷教室
data.action: 双手背在身后伸懒腰挺胸，制服纽扣紧绷，眼神羞怯又满怀期盼地望向前方
data.lighting: 窗外浓烈的橙红落日暖光，勾勒出金色发丝轮廓
data.camera: 侧前方平视特写，捕捉制服线条与微红双颊
data.promptProse: Irina Shidou unwinds in an empty classroom at the end of the school day, stretching her arms behind her head with a relaxed sigh. Her fitted Kuoh Academy blazer and buttoned blouse accentuate her toned figure as golden-red sunset light pours through the tall windows. Her twin-tails catch the amber radiance, her expression shifting from tired satisfaction to a bashful, warm grin.
data.animaCaption: Irina stretches her arms behind her head beside a classroom desk as intense sunset light floods through the windows.
